dialog.title: Book an appointment with {{name}}
dialog.sub: Pick your design and a one-hour slot: it is yours at once.

gate.body: To book a slot with {{name}}, sign in or create your account.
gate.why: An account lets you find and cancel your appointments, and protects artists from fake bookings.

done.title: Appointment booked
done.body: You will receive a confirmation e-mail with the appointment to add to your calendar. The artist may contact you about your project.
done.cancel: Can't make it? Cancel from “My appointments”: it is free until 24 hours before.

design.title: Your design
design.hint: A design from the page, or a custom one you describe.
design.customHint: Describe your idea in the message: shape, colour, tooth, inspiration…

when.title: Your slot
when.error: The slots could not be loaded.
when.closed: This calendar is not taking bookings at the moment.
when.none: No free slot in the coming days. Come back soon.
when.zoneOther: Note: {{city}} time, the artist's time zone.

fields.name: First and last name
fields.commentPlaceholder: Your idea, your questions, an inspiration…

problem.name: Enter your first and last name.
problem.commentLength: The message is at most 1000 characters.

error.session_expired: Your session expired: sign in again, then try again.
error.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your e-mail address first (link sent when you signed up), then try again.
error.closed: This calendar is not taking bookings at the moment.
error.own_calendar: You cannot book in your own calendar.
error.slot_unavailable: This slot is no longer offered. Pick another one.
error.slot_taken: This slot was just booked. Pick another one.
error.limit_artist: You already have an upcoming appointment with this artist.
error.limit_total: You already have 3 upcoming appointments: that is the maximum.
error.limit_daily: Too many bookings today. Try again tomorrow.
error.banned: Bookings are closed to you for now, after missed appointments or late cancellations. See “My appointments”.
error.blocked: This artist does not take bookings from you.
error.item_unavailable: This design is no longer on the page. Pick another one.
error.captcha_required: The anti-robot check did not complete. Try again.
error.captcha_failed: The anti-robot check failed. Try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
error.unavailable: The booking could not be made. Try again in a moment.

info: Your booking, name, e-mail, phone and message are passed on to {{name}}, who will see you and may contact you. They are kept 12 months after the appointment.

viewer.title: Like this design?
viewer.body: Book a slot with {{name}} to have it applied.

artist.actionFailed: The action did not go through

codes.not_cancellable: This appointment can no longer be cancelled.
codes.not_markable: The outcome is recorded after the appointment's hour, and at most 60 days after.

artist.clientErased: The client deleted their account: their details were erased.
artist.blockedDone: This client can no longer book with you
artist.cancelBody: Your client receives an e-mail with the reason you give. The slot is free again on your Glowbook.
artist.cancelled: Appointment cancelled, the client has been told

mine.title: My appointments
mine.description: The appointments booked on artists' Glowbooks. Cancelling is free until 24 hours before.
mine.unavailable: Appointments are not available at the moment.
mine.error: The appointments could not be loaded.
mine.banned: After two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months, bookings are closed to you until {{date}}.
mine.noneUpcoming: No upcoming appointment. Book from an artist's Glowbook.
mine.receivedHint: The appointments clients booked in your calendar: those to come and the past ones whose outcome is still to record.
mine.cancelFree: The artist is told and the slot is free again.
mine.cancelLate: The appointment is less than 24 hours away: the cancellation will be recorded as late. Two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months close bookings for 3 months.
mine.cancelled: Appointment cancelled, the artist has been told

agenda.savedOn: Bookings are open on your Glowbook as soon as it is approved.
agenda.unavailable: The calendar is not available at the moment.

status.switchOff: Bookings are paused on the platform for the moment.
status.disabled: Bookings are closed. Open them to offer your slots on your Glowbook.
status.pending: Your bookings will open as soon as your page is approved.
status.open: Bookings are open: your free slots are offered on your Glowbook.
status.closed: Bookings are closed: they need an active Atelier plan.

agenda.enableHint: Only signed-in members book. Each slot lasts 1 hour and is blocked for you as soon as it is booked; cancel those that do not suit you.

weekProblem.order: Each range must end after it starts.
weekProblem.overlap: Two ranges of the same day overlap.
weekProblem.tooMany: Too many ranges: 28 at most in the week.

agenda.linkNote: While bookings are open, the “Book” button of your page opens this calendar instead of your external booking link.
agenda.weekHint: {{city}} time. Tap an hour to close or open it: block here the appointments taken elsewhere (Planity, phone…).
agenda.saveFirst: Save your settings to edit the week.
agenda.pastHint: After the hour, the appointment moves to “Past appointments to record”: say whether the client came.
agenda.toMarkHint: Did the client come? Record it within 60 days: two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months close their bookings for 3 months.
